WITH signed_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
    END as signed_amount
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    frequency,
    AVG(signed_amount) as account_avg
  FROM signed_trans
  GROUP BY account_id, frequency
),
frequency_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(account_avg) as freq_avg
  FROM account_averages
  GROUP BY frequency
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    aa.account_id,
    aa.frequency,
    aa.account_avg,
    CASE 
      WHEN fa.freq_avg IS NULL OR fa.freq_avg = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE aa.account_avg / fa.freq_avg
    END as ratio
  FROM account_averages aa
  LEFT JOIN frequency_averages fa ON aa.frequency = fa.frequency
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  frequency,
  account_avg,
  ratio
FROM with_ratio
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If a frequency average equals zero, the ratio is returned as NULL to handle division by zero. The request specifies 'missing ratios last' but does not explicitly address the undefined case of 0÷0.
